verdict.rationale: First-party docs show HIPAA, GDPR and PCI DSS supported on the same platform as other frameworks. They cover HIPAA readiness, evidence and assessment, HIPAA-to-Unified Control mapping, GDPR added via the multi-framework approach, and PCI DSS automation with ASV scans and pentesting. Auditor-mapped Unified Controls, framework filtering and multi-framework action items let a new framework be added without duplicate work or a new tool. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-framework coverage beyond vendor claims.
